name: PurpleCAD
description: A parametric CAD application with an OpenCASCADE kernel

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c blue,magenta "vite --port 3000" "npm run addon:build && npm run sqlite:rebuild && ./scripts/dev-bundle-name.sh && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:3000 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; ELECTRON_START_URL=http://localhost:3000 electron ."
scripts.e2e:build: npm run addon:build && VITE_E2E=1 vite build
scripts.test:e2e:gpu: npm run e2e:build && ./scripts/with-display.sh playwright test e2e/pathtrace.spec.js e2e/visual.spec.js
scripts.electron:start: npm run addon:build && npm run sqlite:rebuild && ./scripts/dev-bundle-name.sh && vite build && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; electron .
scripts.electron:build: npm run sqlite:rebuild && vite build && electron-builder --config.mac.target=dmg
scripts.dist: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-arm64: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac-x64: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.dist:all: npm run addon:build && npm run mcp:build && vite build && electron-builder --mac --win --linux --publish never
scripts.icons: python3 scripts/make-app-icons.py && iconutil -c icns app-icons/mac.iconset -o app-icons/icon.icns
scripts.e2e:podman:stop: podman rm -f purple-cad-e2e-run >/dev/null 2>&1; echo 'still running (empty = clean):'; podman ps --filter ancestor=purple-cad-e2e --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}'
